name: XQM BB Blemish Saffron Crocus Base Cream | 6-in-1 Multifunction BB Cream with Hyaluronic Acid & Mineral Pigments | SPF 15 | 65ml
description:
Achieve a smoother, more even-looking and radiant complexion with XQM BB Blemish Saffron Crocus Base Cream. This 6-in-1 multifunction BB cream combines skincare and makeup-base benefits to help moisturize the skin, even out the appearance of skin tone, conceal visible imperfections, and enhance your complexion with a naturally polished finish. Enriched with Hyaluronic Acid, Vitamins A, C, E & F, Caffeine, Hydrolyzed Collagen, Hydrolyzed Elastin, Aloe Vera, and Hydrolyzed Silk, the nourishing formula helps maintain hydrated and refreshed-looking skin. Mineral pigments help visually even out the complexion and conceal the appearance of blemishes and hyperpigmentation, while SPF 15 provides additional protection against UV exposure.
